--- title: System Patterns type: note permalink: system-patterns --- # System Patterns ## Architecture ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Cloudflare Pages (SSR) │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ │ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ Astro 5.0+ │ │ │ │ ┌───────────┐ ┌───────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ │ │ │ │ │ Pages │ │ Layouts │ │ Components │ │ │ │ │ │ /[lang]/ │ │ Base.astro│ │ HeadSEO │ │ │ │ │ └───────────┘ └───────────┘ │ Carousel │ │ │ │ │ │ ContactForm │ │ │ │ │ ┌───────────────────────────┐ └─────────────┘ │ │ │ │ │ Content Collections │ │ │ │ │ │ projects/*.mdx │ │ │ │ │ └───────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ Islands (Client-Side) │ │ │ │ ┌───────────┐ ┌──────┐ ┌─────────────┐ │ │ │ │ │ Alpine.js │ │ HTMX │ │ Hyperscript │ │ │ │ │ │ • modals │ │•forms│ │ • complex │ │ │ │ │ │ • menu │ │•filter│ │ interactions│ │ │ │ │ │ • gallery │ └──────┘ └─────────────┘ │ │ │ │ └───────────┘ │ │ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ## Component Specifications ### HeadSEO Component ```astro --- // src/components/HeadSEO.astro interface Props { title: string; description: string; image?: string; type?: 'website' | 'article'; schema?: 'LocalBusiness' | 'Article' | 'BreadcrumbList'; } --- ``` ### ImageCarouselGallery Component ```astro --- // src/components/ImageCarouselGallery.astro interface Props { images: { src: string; alt: string }[]; } ---
``` Features: - `images[]` prop with alt from Markdown metadata - Alpine.js `activeSlide` state - Touch-swipe support - Keyboard navigation (←/→) - Thumbnail previews ## Design Patterns ### Zero-JS First Decision hierarchy: 1. Can HTML/CSS solve it? → Use that 2. Needs local UI state? → Alpine.js 3. Needs server communication? → HTMX 4. Complex client logic? → Hyperscript ### Progressive Enhancement 1. HTML works without JS (semantic, accessible) 2. HTMX enhances forms and filters 3. Alpine.js adds UI interactivity 4. Hyperscript for complex interactions ### Multilingual Routing ``` src/pages/ ├── [lang]/ │ ├── index.astro # /es/, /ca/, /en/ │ ├── projects/ │ │ ├── index.astro # /es/projects/ │ │ └── [slug].astro # /es/projects/project-name │ └── contact.astro # /es/contact └── index.astro # Redirect to default lang ``` ### Semantic HTML for LLMs - Use `
`, `
`, `
` - Question-based H2/H3 headers - Clear document structure for AI snippet extraction ## Key Decisions | Decision | Rationale | |----------|-----------| | Astro 5.0+ SSR | Content-focused, Islands Architecture, Cloudflare edge | | @astrojs/cloudflare | Edge deployment, Early Hints support | | Alpine.js | Lightweight (15KB), HTML-centric, no build step | | HTMX | Server-driven UI, progressive enhancement | | UnoCSS | Zero-runtime, atomic CSS, fast | | MDX for projects | Embed components in content, type-safe frontmatter | | Bun | Fast JavaScript runtime and package manager | ## File Structure ``` src/ ├── components/ │ ├── HeadSEO.astro │ ├── ImageCarouselGallery.astro │ ├── ContactForm.astro │ ├── Navigation.astro │ └── Footer.astro ├── content/ │ ├── config.ts │ └── projects/ │ ├── es/ │ ├── ca/ │ └── en/ ├── layouts/ │ └── Base.astro ├── pages/ │ ├── [lang]/ │ └── index.astro └── styles/ └── global.css ``` ## Technical Constraints Discovered ### Astro 5.x Content Collections with Glob Loader ```typescript // src/content/config.ts import { defineCollection, z } from 'astro:content'; import { glob } from 'astro/loaders'; // NOT from 'astro:content' const projects = defineCollection({ loader: glob({ pattern: '**/*.{md,mdx}', base: 'src/content/projects' }), schema: z.object({ ... }), }); ``` **Key differences from legacy collections:** - `glob` must be imported from `'astro/loaders'` - Entry `id` is the full path (e.g., `es/la-trobada`) - No `slug` property - derive from `id` - Use `render(entry)` function instead of `entry.render()` ### MDX Special Characters In MDX files, angle brackets `<` are parsed as JSX. Escape using HTML entities: - `<50 m²` → `<50 m²` ### Project Slug Handling ```typescript // projects/index.astro - list page const slug = project.id.replace(`${lang}/`, ''); // projects/[slug].astro - detail page const project = projects.find(p => p.id === `${lang}/${slug}`); const { Content } = await render(project); // NOT project.render() ``` ## Components ### Carousel.astro Reusable image carousel with Alpine.js: - Located: `src/components/Carousel.astro` - Features: Keyboard navigation (left/right arrows), touch support - Props: `images: string[]`, `alt: string`, `id?: string` ## MCP Servers ### Chrome DevTools MCP - Command: `npx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest` - Purpose: Browser automation, debugging, performance analysis - Added via: `claude mcp add chrome-devtools` ## Build Configuration ### UnoCSS fontSize Format Use tuple format for custom font sizes: ```typescript fontSize: { 'xs': ['0.875rem', 'normal'], // [size, lineHeight] 'xl': ['2rem', '1'], } ``` Object format `{ lineHeight: '...' }` causes esbuild minification warnings. ### Vite SSR Externals Node built-in modules used in SSR utils must be externalized: ```javascript vite: { ssr: { external: ['node:crypto', 'node:path'], }, } ``` ### Suppressing Library Warnings HTMX uses eval for `hx-on:*` handlers (safe, by design). Suppress via Rollup: ```javascript build: { rollupOptions: { onwarn(warning, warn) { if (warning.code === 'EVAL' && warning.id?.includes('htmx')) return; warn(warning); }, }, } ``` ### UnoCSS Auto-Injection With `@unocss/astro` integration using `injectReset: true`, do not manually import `virtual:uno.css` - causes duplicate import warnings. ### Edge-Compatible Hashing For Cloudflare Workers compatibility, use DJB2 hash instead of Node.js crypto: ```typescript function djb2Hash(str: string): string { let hash = 5381; for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) { hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) ^ str.charCodeAt(i); } return Math.abs(hash).toString(16).slice(0, 8); } ``` Must be synchronized between build-time (`optimize-images.ts`) and runtime. ## Translations System ### Architecture Centralized JSON translations editable via TinaCMS: ``` src/content/translations/ ├── es.json # Spanish (primary/fallback) ├── ca.json # Catalan └── en.json # English ``` ### Content Collection Config ```typescript // src/content/config.ts import { glob } from 'astro/loaders'; const translations = defineCollection({ loader: glob({ pattern: '*.json', base: 'src/content/translations' }), schema: z.object({ nav: z.object({ social, menu, letsTalk, about, projects, services, contact }), footer: z.object({ privacy, legal }), contactForm: z.object({ ... }), // ... }), }); ``` **Important:** Use `glob` loader, not `file` - file loader doesn't support glob patterns. ### Utility Function ```typescript // src/utils/translations.ts export async function getTranslations(lang: string) { const entry = await getEntry('translations', lang); if (!entry) { const fallback = await getEntry('translations', 'es'); if (!fallback) throw new Error(`No translations found`); return fallback.data; } return entry.data; } ``` ### Component Usage Pattern Components accept optional `translations` prop to avoid refetching: ```astro --- import { getTranslations, type Translations } from '../utils/translations'; interface Props { lang: string; translations?: Translations; } const { lang, translations: propTranslations } = Astro.props; const t = propTranslations ?? await getTranslations(lang); --- ``` ### TinaCMS Integration Translations editable under separate collections per language: - 🇪🇸 Translations (Spanish) - 🏴󠁥󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 Translations (Catalan) - 🇬🇧 Translations (English) Uses `match: { include: 'xx' }` to target specific JSON files. ## Cloudflare Integrations ### Turnstile (Spam Protection) Invisible CAPTCHA for contact form: ```astro

title: Organize Senshac around four locality boundaries
rationale: Use semantic HTML/CSS, Alpine.js, and HTMX for locality of behavior; Astro and statically extractable UnoCSS for locality of presentation; TinaCMS and GitHub for locality of change; and static-first Cloudflare Pages with Workers/R2 only at dynamic delivery boundaries. This reduces global runtime work and makes each concern discoverable beside its owner.

content: Repository cleanup requires two independent forms of evidence before deletion: no live source/config/documentation reference, plus confirmation that the file is not a framework-generated artifact, filesystem route, package-script entrypoint, dynamically imported integration, Worker entrypoint, or active operational tool. Static-analysis output alone is insufficient.

name: Senshac Astro portfolio architecture
description:
Objective:
Senshac is a static-first Astro portfolio on Cloudflare Pages using UnoCSS for colocated presentation, Alpine.js for local client state, HTMX for server interactions, TinaCMS plus GitHub for content change, and Cloudflare Workers/R2 for dynamic delivery and media.

Constraints:
- Zero-JS first: prefer semantic HTML and CSS, then Alpine.js for component-local state, then HTMX for server interaction.
- Utility classes must be statically extractable by UnoCSS; CMS choices map to bounded semantic tokens and generated safelists.
- Public content routes are prerendered by default; only contact, Tina island, media, and other genuine API routes execute on Workers.
- Use stable R2 media IDs with AVIF/WebP 412/768/1200 variants and HLS manifests; repository media and build-time image optimization are retired.
- Keep media ingestion in senshac-media-raw and immutable public delivery in senshac-media-prod through media.senshac.com.
- Maintain multilingual content and canonical studio, works, and methods routes.

Acceptance:
- Astro check/build passes inside Flox with Bun without hyperscript, unused Alpine plugins, or deprecated UnoCSS presets.
- Ordinary pages are delivered as static assets while Tina visual editing and dynamic API routes remain functional.
- HTMX contact submission works with and without JavaScript, renders validation errors, and enforces Turnstile in production.
- UnoCSS emits every Alpine state class, responsive content variant, and bounded Tina icon without a browser runtime.
- Images, fonts, and HLS media return correct MIME/cache headers from media.senshac.com.
- Navigation, project pages, contact flow, SEO endpoints, and TinaCMS admin remain accessible and functional.

name: Senshac content and brand model
description:
Objective:
Preserve and evolve the Sens*Hac multilingual brand and service content according to owner-approved WEB.pdf revisions, including homepage positioning, detailed method phases and service tiers, works/projects, founder story, contact content, and curated Novedades posts.

Constraints:
- Use Spanish, Catalan, and English content consistently; owner approval is required before translating revised Spanish source copy.
- Keep question-based headings and semantic HTML where compatible with the approved editorial design.
- Novedades posts use structured tags, visibility, ordering, locale, destination, and R2 media fields rather than runtime Instagram scraping.
- WEB.pdf remains a reference artifact and is not a runtime content source.

Acceptance:
- Approved homepage, methods, works, founder, contact, and project facts are represented in Tina content or tracked by a specific Seed.
- Novedades filtering and ordering are deterministic and editor-controlled.

name: TinaCMS visual editing for Astro
description:
Objective:
Enable TinaCMS visual/contextual editing on preview.senshac.com for Astro-rendered content without converting the site to React. Editors should be able to open Tina admin, see the routed page preview, click editable page regions, and see live updates while editing supported fields.

Constraints:
- Use @tinacms/astro rather than React useTina; keep the site Astro-first and preserve Cloudflare Pages SSR deployment.
- Do not expose Tina tokens in generated files, dist output, logs, or git history; keep Betterleaks scans clean.
- Start with one representative page before expanding to all templates.

Acceptance:
- Spanish home page has click-to-edit markers and live preview for hero/title/image/intro content.
- At least one project detail page has click-to-edit markers and live preview for title, description, cover image, and gallery metadata.
- Tina admin on preview.senshac.com routes to the page preview and reflects edits without requiring a full rebuild.
- bun run check, bun run build, Betterleaks git, and nonignored worktree Betterleaks scan pass.
